rationale: design-import-refactor: generic change landed in Pulp per owner decision 2026-10-04; Vellum inherits (see inheritance ledger); the SkSL chart composer behind Canvas::draw_sdf_shape_with_shader takes the canvas's local-to-device linear map as a uniform and reports PulpChart.tan in device orientation, flipping the sign of cross under a mirroring map so the offset cross * (tan.y, -tan.x) is unchanged. A chart drawn through a rotation, such as a vertical fader track drawn as the horizontal stadium turned a quarter, is therefore lit on screen instead of in the turned frame. Draws without a transform, including every untransformed knob chart, see the values they saw before; t, d, side, px, valid and halfWidth are unchanged. No design-import, Chromium, packaging or authority boundary moves; the Pulp canvas target has not adopted a Vellum package.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'SDF chart reports tan in device orientation'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'fader chart presets are lit on screen on vertical and horizontal tracks'
